# Map header context flags to API names explicitly

The internal boolean onHeaderPaneLink maps to the external context string header_pane_link; the schema declares the same string. Preserve that explicit camelCase-to-snake_case mapping when adding sibling contexts. This is a scoped existing namespace pattern, not a blanket instruction to rename all DOM IDs or JavaScript event names to snake_case. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: extension menu naming.
